Package wellen

Interface MIDI

All Known Implementing Classes:
Note
public interface MIDI
MIDI constants.

note names follow scientific pitch notation i.e NOTE_C4 = 60 ( middle C ) and NOTE_A4 = 69 ( 440Hz ). sharps are written with an S e.g NOTE_CS4 = 61 ( C#4 ).
